about_the_game:
This game will be able to completely immerse you in the world of backstage rooms.

The game has worked out the plot to the smallest detail, don't forget that you can't give up and there's always a way out

The game will surprise you with stunning graphics that are hard to distinguish from a real camera

-The game uses high-quality real-time Consecration, as well as sound plug-ins, with which you can achieve a magnificent echo sound-

-With updates, we plan to add multiplayer, and naturally make much more levels

We are available in Telegram, Discord, Youtube
